description: This file defines the `TypeManifestOptions` class, which is used to configure and manage known types for serialization-related code generation in Orleans. It includes properties for specifying serializers, copiers, converters, interfaces, proxies, and metadata mappings.

classes.name: TypeManifestOptions
classes.description: A configuration class for managing known serialization types, proxies, and related metadata in Orleans serialization.

methods.name: EnableConfigurationAnalysis
methods.description: Property to enable or disable serializer configuration analysis.
